query: Who is automatically eligible for the Premium Cap and Phased Support provided under MediShield Life?
reference_answer: All Singapore Citizens and Permanent Residents, regardless of household income and Annual Value of their residences, are automatically eligible.
answer: Individuals aged 50 and above who are permanent residents and have paid into MediShield Life for at least 20 years are automatically eligible for the Premium Cap and Phased Support. [Document 1]
